title: rosa canina sphaerica
intro: Rosa canina sphaerica, commonly known as Dwarf Wild Rose, is a shrub-like plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa canina sphaerica include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce the severity of conditions such as arthritis and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids.
